project_type: TypeScript Node.js autonomous crypto agent (Solana) with microservices (Rust executor, Go orchestrator)
build_system: npm with tsc (TypeScript 5.8), vitest for testing
test_framework: vitest with tests/ directory structure mirroring src/, mock-heavy unit tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm install` 2. Run `npm run build` to type-check 3. Run `npm test` (vitest run) to verify all 489+ tests pass
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full npm install and build available. Node.js 24+ required.
contribution_requirements: TypeScript strict mode, ESM modules with .js extension imports, vitest for testing
key_patterns: Classes exported from src/, Winston logger via createLogger(), zod config schema in src/config.ts, service clients use fetch with AbortController timeouts, tests in tests/ mirror src/ structure
directory_structure: src/ - source TypeScript (core/, integrations/, services/, strategies/, telegram/, types/), tests/ - vitest tests mirroring src structure, services/ - Rust/Go microservices, data/ - SQLite DB
